 Advertisement Opinion Editorial: Veterans Day 2026
 Advertisement Updated: 12:21 PM EST Nov 6, 2026 Editorial Standards ⓘ Opinion Editorial: Veterans Day 2026
 Updated: 12:21 PM EST Nov 6, 2026 Editorial Standards ⓘ GREENVILLE, S.C. — Every day is a great day to thank a veteran for defending our country, and especially next week as we celebrate Veterans Day--veterans like Marc Allen and Adam Niespodziani, our colleagues here at WYFF4.
 And back in September, our WYFF News 4 team documented a milestone honor flight. It was the first time the Honor Flight Upstate South Carolina chapter, from GSP to our nation’s capital, included Vietnam veterans.
 Advertisement On Monday, Tuesday and Wednesday night on WYFF News 4 at 7 p.m. on CBS Carolina, you’ll meet the veterans who received the ultimate thank you.
 Among them was Mortimer Sams, one of the oldest living World War Two veterans, at 100, and Jimmy Greer, who found the names of nine of his friends killed over nine months during the Vietnam War on the memorial in Washington D.C.
 We owe them so much. So please, take a moment to honor a veteran for their service and sacrifice for our country. And never forget that our freedoms come at a price they were willing to pay.
